Explain briefly why condensation appears on the outside of a glass of iced water on a humid day. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: On a humid day, the air contains abundant water vapor. When this warm, moist air contacts the cold glass surface, it cools rapidly. This causes the gaseous water vapor to condense, turning into liquid water droplets on the glass's exterior.
